settings.assembly_desc: Add professional assembly for your new Rugby Bed.

settings.title: Gas-Lift Ottoman Storage
settings.description: Lift the mattress platform to reveal four generous storage sections beneath the bed. The gas-assisted mechanism makes the storage area easier to open and close.

settings.title: LED Smart Headboard
settings.description: Create a warm evening glow with the integrated headboard lighting. Concealed flip-down compartments keep smaller bedside essentials close without adding clutter.

settings.title: Charging Within Reach
settings.description: Charge compatible devices using the built-in wireless charging pad or the integrated USB ports, conveniently positioned in the headboard.

settings.title: Integrated Speakers
settings.description: Two speakers are built into the smart headboard, letting you enjoy music, podcasts or audiobooks without filling your bedside cabinet with extra equipment.

settings.heading: Explore the Rugby Bed
settings.subheading: See each finish and the storage and technology built into the frame.

settings.question: Which sizes are available?
settings.answer: The Rugby Bed is available in Single (3ft), Double (4ft6) and King (5ft).

settings.question: Which colours are available?
settings.answer: Choose from White, Walnut, Grey or Black high-gloss finishes.

settings.question: Is the smart headboard included?
settings.answer: Yes. The fixed headboard, LED lighting, integrated speakers, wireless charging pad, USB ports and concealed headboard storage are included with the bed frame.

settings.question: Does the bed include under-bed storage?
settings.answer: Yes. The mattress platform lifts using a gas-assisted mechanism to reveal four divided storage sections.

settings.question: Is a mattress included?
settings.answer: No. The price is for the bed frame and fixed smart headboard. The mattress, bedside cabinets, bedding and decorative accessories shown in the images are sold separately.

settings.question: Will wireless charging work with every phone?
settings.answer: Wireless charging requires a compatible device. Other compatible devices can be charged using the integrated USB ports.
